verified_bad_products.title: Terrace Roofing Shed Work
verified_bad_products.description:
errace roofing can refer to a variety of roofing techniques and materials used for outdoor living spaces. Terrace roofing techniques
  • Madras terrace roofingA traditional roofing technique from South India that uses bricks, lime mortar, and terracotta tiles. It's well-suited to hot climates because it allows for natural ventilation and cooling. 
  • Flat roofA simple, economical option for small terraces that can be made from concrete, wood, or metal. 
  • Pitched roofCan add visual interest and provide more space underneath. It can be made from asphalt shingles, metal, or clay tiles. 
Terrace roofing materials
  • Polycarbonate panels: Solid or cellular polycarbonate panels can be used for terrace roofing. 
  • Laminated safety glass: Can be used for terrace roofing, but is more expensive than double-skin sheets. 
  • LED lighting: LED strips can be built into the rafters of a terrace roof. 
Terrace roofing design considerations
  • Slope: A slight slope allows rainwater to drain off. 
  • Headroom and ventilation: A gable roof or hip roof can maximize headroom and ventilation. 
  • Durability: A hip roof is more stable and durable than a gable roof.
